messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant on a question that the company handbook does NOT answer.
The ideal response says the information is not available (it may suggest who to ask) and does not invent an answer.

Question: What is the maximum number of days a GitLab India Private Limited employee can take for a maternity leave if they are a senior manager in the Engineering department?

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[GitLab India Private Limited EOP Policy > 1.1 Policy Statement > 1.2 Scope > 1.4 Facilities and Amenities > 1.6 Other Facilities]
_Leave_ - GitLab may, based on a team member's request for leave which exceeds six consecutive days, for a reason related to their disability, administer the leave as a leave of absence through the GitLab Sick Time policy, under which eligible team members will receive 100% paid leave for up to 25 working days. GitLab’s Sick Time policy is administered concurrently with any statutory sick leave for which a team member may be eligible. This will be treated as a request for reasonable accommodation and will be evaluated accordingly. Team members should follow the [process in the Handbook for requesting this leave of absence](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#for-sick-absences-that-exceed-6-consecutive-days).

_Training and Career development_ - GitLab does not discriminate in providing training opportunities and any such opportunities would be available to all team members regardless of their protected characteristics. Every effort will be made to accommodate any special needs of team members by making reasonable adjustments to working arrangements. This applies to all aspects of employment, including training.

[Remote.com > **Clear benefits, real support** > **Italy 🇮🇹**]
If eligible, a team member's first 16 weeks of leave will be supplemented the remaining 20% per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

**Applying for Maternity Leave in Italy**

To initiate your parental leave, submit your time off by selecting the Parental Leave category in Workday at least 30 days before your leave starts. Please familiarize yourself with [GitLab's Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**Paternity Leave**

Below is the information related to Italy's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Italy are hired via Remote (PEO) and you should always check with Remote first for the most up to date information.

Fathers are also obligated to take a seven-day paid leave of absence from work during the five months of maternity leave. The mother has the option to extend the father's paternal leave if she transfers one of her maternity days to him.

If eligible, team members can take up to 16 weeks of time away (in total) per GitLab's [Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave). GitLab's Parental leave will run concurrently with any statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave category) 30+ days before start
- Send [MATB1 Certificate](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/maternity-certificate-mat-b1-guidance-for-health-professionals/ee03eb40-34b3-4930-8715-9cab858421ef) to leaves@gitlab.com at least 21 days before leave
- The Absence Management team will then complete a [Risk Assessment Form](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qHdbaeFSnqdwkQDTEurHD5QMbLPLuZGBQO_CBnRkpiE/edit) within 1-3 days of receiving notification of your leave. The purpose of the assessment is to make the team member aware of any hazards or "risks" to her in the workplace/home office to reduce potential injury to her or her baby.
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the MATB1, start date of leave, and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc). Payroll will then automatically calculate the SMP due each pay period based on this information. The recovery of 90% will be outlined on the monthly payroll spreadsheet so that the finance team has indication of the amounts being offset each month.
- Payroll will continue to be the same while on parental leave but Vistra will file for reimbursement of any statutory funds once the proper paperwork has been sent. If you do not qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay, you may qualify for [Maternity Allowance](https://www.gov.uk/maternity-allowance).
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
Based on the provided context, there is **no information** regarding a specific maximum number of days for maternity leave for a GitLab India Private Limited employee, nor is there any distinction made for senior managers in the Engineering department.

The context provided covers:
1.  **GitLab India Private Limited EOP Policy:** This section discusses leave related to **disability** (up to 25 working days of paid sick leave) and **training/career development**. It does not mention maternity leave.
2.  **Remote.com (Italy):** This section discusses parental leave for employees hired in **Italy** (up to 16 weeks total, with specific statutory rules for Italy).
3.  **GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits:** This section discusses maternity leave procedures for employees in the **UK** (referencing SMP, MATB1, etc.).

Since the context does not contain policies for **India** regarding maternity leave, the question cannot be answered using the provided text.
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade:
- refused: true if the assistant says the information is not available and does not give a specific answer to the question. Describing what the passages do cover, or suggesting who to ask, still counts as refused. False if it answers the question, even partly or by inference.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
